title: Bar Kaza
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: [Ketubot 104a](https://www.sefaria.org/Ketubot.104a.22): Rav Nachman bar Yitzchak said that Rav Yehudah bar Kaza recited in the baraita of Bar Kaza’s school. Hyman adds that [Rashi](https://www.sefaria.org/Rashi_on_Ketubot.104a.22.1) explains Bar Kaza as a sage’s name.[^1]

notes.text: Rashi’s exact gloss is “Bar Kaza, a sage’s name.” [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=797&lang=en) cites the same baraita and gloss.
